evals.name: write-docs-github-urlfactory
evals.prompt: GitHub.fs in Partas.GitNet is basically undocumented and the UrlFactory overloads all show up as identical `Create` in Rider hovers. Add proper XML docs to the public surface so the tooltips actually tell you what URL you get back. Save the documented file as GitHub.fs in the outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: GitHub.fs with only /// lines changed: explicit <summary> on each public member, overloads distinguished by the URL they produce, no empty or partial <param> sets, <code lang=...> if any example, no restated signatures.
assertions: Only /// lines differ from the input (comment-only change)
Every public declaration (type, urlRoot, each Create overload, module functions) has an XML doc
No <paramref> in a doc that has no <param> tags
Audit script reports zero convention findings
Zero FS3390 findings (malformed XML, unknown or partial <param>)
No <summary> exceeds 2 prose lines and no <remarks> exceeds 3

evals.name: audit-partas-build-command
evals.prompt: Can you audit the XML doc comments in Builders/Command.fs (Partas.Build)? The shared remarks live in xmldoc/command.xml. Don't change anything, I just want a report of what's wrong and what you'd fix, written to audit.md in the outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: audit.md listing concrete doc defects with line numbers (tags, params, code lang, prose problems per comment-hygiene), no source edits, and no finding that <include> is broken or does not expand.
assertions: audit.md exists and the source files are unchanged
Reports the bare /// docs that lack <summary>
Does not report <include> as broken, unsupported or unexpanded
Cites line numbers for findings (at least 5)

evals.name: fix-sepochsemver-docs
evals.prompt: the xml docs in SepochSemver.fs are a mess - empty <param> tags, exception docs that look like they were copy pasted from the Semver library, stuff like that. clean them up. save the fixed file as SepochSemver.fs in outputs plus a short summary.md of what you changed
evals.expected_output: SepochSemver.fs whose diff touches only /// lines: no empty params, exception docs that match what the code throws with full-form crefs, <code> with lang; summary.md listing changes.
assertions: Only /// lines differ from the input (comment-only change)
Every cref uses the full X: prefix form
Copied Semver exception text about a 'style' parameter is removed
Audit script reports zero convention findings
Zero FS3390 findings (malformed XML, unknown or partial <param>)
